notes.heading: Comparing
notes.text: Toggle the reference against either render. The reference mesh is two overlapping bodies, the hub and the spigot (an I-shaped stub of the bore's section from x 26.5 to 28.5 lies wholly inside the hub), so a parity reading near the spigot's root counts the overlap as void. dist would charge the faces inside the hub, so render.rs --verify gates the previous render against the derived reference 420-001_EndArmHub.bodies-unioned.stl, the two bodies unioned (the 420-001_EndArmHub.scad header), and holds four sections by outline against the original. The revised render presses S1 on the 6703, T2 in the C-505 tube and T1 round it, and slips B1 round the End Arm Hub Cap. Run render.rs --verify before building this page, because the renders are its output.
